lines.text_source: [14][C1]@"Let's hurry and try[01]to get over them[01]before it gets dark."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][C1]@"But don't worry.[02]We should be able to[01]jump over this."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][C1]@"All you have to do[01]to jump is stand at[02]a place where it's[01]narrow enough to[01]jump,[02]and press the [7F][01]button[02]or move in the[01]direction you want[02]to jump using the[01][05][02]directional buttons[06].[01]Try it!"

lines.text_source: [0C][04][14][C1]@"...[0B]...[0B]See? It's[01]easy, isn't it?[01]One more to go."

lines.base_translation: [0C][04][14][C1]@"...[0B]...[0B]Viu? E facil, nao e? Mais um."

lines.text_source: [0C][04][14][C1]@"Are you afraid of[01]heights?[02]I'm a Wyndian--we[01]love high places."

lines.base_translation: [0C][04][14][C1]@"Tem medo de altura?[02]Eu sou de Wyndia--a gente adora lugares altos."

lines.text_source: [14][C1]@"Good thing you were[01]able to jump--we're[01]really high up!"

lines.base_translation: [14][80]@"Nao e legal aquela sensacao de[02]olhar para baixo de um lugar tao alto?[02]Me deixa tonta--e tao emocionante!"

lines.text_source: [14][81]@"Are...[0B]Are you all[01]right, [04]

lines.text_source: [14][82]@"You're not hurt, are[01]you?[02]I'm sorry. I didn't[01]tell you about my[01]wings...[02]I can use them to[01]fly a little, so I[02]can survive a fall[01]like that."
